set.body: Studio (eyes4s-7e) asked on 2026-09-26, from the S2.1 review. Studio schemas (eyes4s.studio.document@1 on a CR3 SchemaLadder) currently call DefinitionId.builtIn. That constructor is private[eyes4s], which studio reaches only because its package is under eyes4s, and AGENTS.md reserves it for registered built-ins, which must have a registry entry, law and pinned fixture. Wanted: a public, namespaced host constructor, e.g. DefinitionId.host(namespace, name, version): Either[PlanError, DefinitionId]. It must reject the reserved core namespace (plain 'eyes4s.' built-ins) unless the namespace is declared a host namespace such as 'eyes4s.studio'; it is exempt from the built-in registry/law/fixture requirement; and SchemaRegistryJvmSuite must be able to tell host ids apart and refuse any found in a *Definitions object. Add a typeCheckErrors or law test showing host ids cannot collide with built-ins. Then migrate studio's schema ids to it, which is a studio-side change.
set.title: Host-declared DefinitionId constructor for application schemas
